speaker: narrator
text: What if you could *eat sunlight*?

speaker: narrator
text: Meet Jay. Jay is broke. *Ketchup soup* broke.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, lunch costs fifteen dollars. I have *four*.

speaker: bit
text: Then meet my new hero. A *sea slug*.

speaker: bit
text: It eats algae and keeps their *solar panels*.

speaker: bit
text: Tiny green parts that make sugar *from light*.

speaker: bit
text: It turns green and can go *months* without eating.

speaker: hero
text: Months? Without *food*?

speaker: bit
text: So I made a smoothie. Algae, plus *my code*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, it smells like a *pond*.

speaker: bit
text: Drink it. Then go stand in the *sun*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay drinks it. Every last, *slimy* drop.

speaker: narrator
text: Nothing happens. For one *full* minute.

speaker: narrator
text: Then his hands start to turn *green*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: Bit. Bit! Why am I a *salad*?

speaker: bit
text: Not a salad. A walking *solar panel*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay steps outside into the morning *sun*.

speaker: narrator
text: And his stomach stops *growling*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: I'm full? From just *standing here*?

speaker: bit
text: Jay. You just ate breakfast. With your *face*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part two drops in two days.
